record.label: Estimated cost and sampled error of the Häner baseline
record.statement: For Häner et al.’s $(35,3,3)$ configuration, the paper estimates the cost of the two dominant reversible subcircuits using 245 qubits and $440{,}576$ $T$ gates. It reports a maximum error of approximately $10^{-6}$.
record.boundary: The authors multiply the larger workspace width, 245, by the two reported block counts to give $107{,}941{,}120$. This partial estimate omits persistent registers and the branch-selection and combination circuits. The baseline sketch uses a zero output register.
